message.title: Induct AS – Registration of supplemental prospectus
message.body:
NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION OR RELEASE, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN OR INTO THE UNITED STATES, CANADA, AUSTRALIA, THE HONG KONG SPECIAL ADMINISTRATIVE REGION OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA OR JAPAN OR ANY OTHER JURISDICTION IN WHICH THE DISTRIBUTION OR RELEASE WOULD BE UNLAWFUL. OTHER RESTRICTIONS ARE APPLICABLE. PLEASE SEE THE IMPORTANT NOTICE AT THE END OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT

Reference is made to the stock exchange announcement published by Induct AS (the "Company") on 22 June 2026 regarding the registration of a national prospectus for a partially underwritten rights issue raising gross proceeds of up to NOK 20 million (the "Prospectus"). Reference is also made to the stock exchange announcement published by the Company on 6 August 2026 regarding the appointment of Karl Erik Brøten as new Chief Financial Officer (CFO) in the Company.

The Company announces that a supplemental prospectus has today, 6 August 2026, been registered with the Norwegian Register of Business Enterprises (“NRBE”) in accordance with chapter 7 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act (the "Supplemental Prospectus"). The Supplemental Prospectus has been prepared to supplement the Prospectus with information that Karl Erik Brøten has accepted an offer to join the Company as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) on a part-time basis. The information contained in the Supplemental Prospectus shall be considered as an integral part of the Prospectus, and is to be read together with the Prospectus. Neither the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway nor any other public authority has carried out any form of review, control, or approval of the Supplemental Prospectus. The Supplemental Prospectus does not constitute an EEA prospectus.

Upon joining the Company, Brøten is expected to assume the CFO role following the planned completion of Eli Cathrine Disch's interim CFO assignment. Disch will continue to serve as a member of the Board of Directors of Induct, ensuring continuity in the Company's governance and strategic oversight.

Karl Erik Brøten is a senior finance executive with more than 25 years of leadership experience from Norwegian and international businesses, primarily within telecom, software and technology businesses. Prior to accepting the offer from Induct, Brøten served as interim Head of Finance for Arribatec ASA, a publicly listed software and digital business solutions company listed on Euronext Growth.

He has held several CFO positions within the Telenor Group, including in Hungary, Pakistan, Malaysia and Bangladesh, and has also served as CFO of Telia Norway and Gulf Bridge International in Qatar.
The Supplemental Prospectus will be made is available on the Company's website, www.induct.net/investor,  and through Norne Securities AS, www.norne.no/induct.

This information is published subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act and in accordance with the requirements of the Continuing Obligations.
